# Format: JPG|tag|width|height|hex(RGBA8 input pixels)|hex(complete JPEG file bytes).
# Reference behavior: probe Temp/opencode/jpgprobe driving the shipped
# StbImageWriteSharp.dll `ImageWriter.WriteJpg` with RGBA input and `default`
# (zero) quality (SDK 10.0.401). Zero quality selects the quality-90
# quantization tables; sampling is 4:2:0 with standard Huffman tables.
JPG|black8|8|8||
JPG|white8|8|8||
JPG|red8|8|8||
JPG|green8|8|8||
JPG|blue8|8|8||
JPG|gray128_8|8|8||
JPG|impulse8|8|8||
JPG|chromasplit16|16|16||
JPG|odd3x5|3|5|000080ff500080ffa00080ff002880ff502880ffa02880ff005080ff505080ffa05080ff007880ff507880ffa07880ff00a080ff50a080ffa0a080ff|
JPG|chromaline16|16|16||
